headline: Policy Committee to discuss 2027-28 school calendar, emergency management plan, and a new animals-in-schools policy.
summary: The committee will review the draft 2026-27 meeting schedule, vote on the 2027-28 school calendar and the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan, and hold a first discussion on a new Animals in Schools policy. It will also begin discussing screen time and device use.
items: Discuss draft 2026-27 Policy Committee schedule and set expectations
Discuss and vote on Policy ICA: 2027-28 school calendar (carryover from June)
Discuss and vote on EBCA Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan (carryover from June)
First discussion of Policy IMG: Animals in Schools
Introductory discussion on screen time and device use
Upcoming meeting dates: October 14, 2026, November 18, 2026, December 2, 2026
